title: Rural Home Loans Late Charge Booking — Servicing Desk Tool Card
content:
A late charge is owed on a Rural Home Loans monthly payment that is still not paid in full after its grace period, and it is booked against that monthly bill; the grace period, the one-charge-per-payment limit and the months that carry no charge are those of the late charge rule of the product. No late charge is assessed on a forborne month or while the loan is in nonaccrual status.

## What booking a late charge does

Booking records one late-charge assessment against the monthly bill named, dated today, and adds the amount to the fees the loan has outstanding. The charge is then carried on the loan's ledger: it appears in the loan's payment history as a late-charge fee pointing to that monthly bill, and the loan's unpaid fees rise by the amount booked. Nothing is collected by this action.

## How it is invoked

The tool is `assess_late_charge_eed44226`, an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `loan_id` | the loan number of the Country Home loan, as returned by the home loan lookup | identifier |
| `source_ref_id` | the reference number of the monthly interest bill (the monthly payment) the charge is booked against, as shown in the loan's payment history | identifier |
| `late_charge_amount` | the late charge in USD | 2 decimal places, always positive, the figure already rounded to the cent |

## Return

A dictionary receipt:

- `fee_txn_id` — reference number of the late-charge entry, a string;
- `source_ref_id` — the monthly bill charged, a string;
- `amount` — the charge booked, USD to 2 decimal places;
- `fees_due` — the loan's unpaid fees after the booking, USD to 2 decimal places;
- `status` — "booked" when the charge is on the loan.

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

A call with `loan_id` HL-0001, `source_ref_id` BILL-0007 and `late_charge_amount` 48.00 on a loan with 30.00 of unpaid fees returns a receipt showing `amount` 48.00, `fees_due` 78.00 and `status` "booked"; the payment history then shows a late-charge fee of 48.00 pointing to BILL-0007.
